# theme-baseline spec

**Feature**: Scriptlog default "blog" theme - frontend baseline
**Generated by**: Playwright Planner Agent (per `prompts/11-master-playwright-planner.md`)
**App**: Scriptlog, PHP >= 7.4, MVC, Bootstrap 4, jQuery
**Bootstrap**: use `e2e/seed.spec.ts` and `playwright.config.js`
**Baseline contract**: captures current rendered behavior BEFORE remediation so later phases
regression-check against it.

---

## Purpose

Smoke-test every public frontend surface of the active default theme and lock down the
baseline UI contract (header, footer, 404, post/page/archive/search/download). Ensures the
theme renders without JS errors, returns correct HTTP statuses, is responsive and
accessible, before any refactor (Plan section 5.2, Phase 0).

---

## URLs

| Route | Pattern |
|-------|---------|
| Home | `/` |
| Blog list | `/blog` |
| Single post | `/post/{id}/{slug}` |
| Static page | `/page/{slug}` |
| Category | `/category/{slug}` |
| Tag | `/tag/{tag}` |
| Monthly archive | `/archive/{mm}/{yyyy}` |
| Archive index | `/archives` |
| Search | `/search?q=keyword` |
| Privacy | `/privacy` |
| Download page | `/download/{identifier}` |
| Download file | `/download/{identifier}/file` |
| Not found | any unknown path |

---

## Preconditions

- Clean/fresh install OR seeded `blogware_test` database with at least:
  - 1 published blog post (with media), known `{id}` and `{slug}`
  - 1 static page ("about-us"), known `{slug}`
  - 1 active category, 1 tag
  - a published post within the current month/year for the archive route
- Default theme `blog` is active.
- App reachable at the configured `baseURL` (Playwright `webServer` boots it).
- UI is English (default locale) for deterministic assertions.

---

## User Actions

- Load each URL directly (browser address bar).
- Click primary nav links; ensure each non-JS href navigates (no dead `href="#"` traps in nav).
- Click a post card -> opens `/post/{id}/{slug}`.
- Click category / tag / archive widgets in the sidebar.
- Use the sidebar search form: type keyword, press Enter (no-JS fallback path `/search?q=`).
- Click "Load More Comments" (enhancement; skip in no-JS).
- Back / forward buttons; browser refresh; resize viewport between desktop/tablet/mobile.
- Open in multiple tabs to ensure shared state is not corrupted.

---

## Expected Behaviour

- Every route returns 200 and renders header + content + footer exactly once (no duplicate
  `<html>`, `<head>`, nav, or footer; templates never call `call_theme_header/footer`).
- Home shows hero (featured), intro, featured-posts, latest-posts, and a gallery section.
- Single post shows: thumbnail, title, author, date, comment count, sanitized content,
  tags, previous/next links, and (when `comment_permit=open`) the comment form.
- Unknown path shows the 404 template with HTTP 404 and a "Back to Home" link.
- Page title updates per route; `<html lang>` and `dir` correct.
- No broken links to missing assets (imgs, css, js 200s).

---

## Validation Rules

- No `http_response_code`/`exit` calls inside any template (this refactor fixture).
- Content rendered is escaped (no raw `&lt;script&gt;`); no un-encoded user text.
- Navigation menu reflects `tbl_menu` public items with sort order.
- Pagination controls (prev/next/pages) correct when a list exceeds page size.
- Search: empty query shows prompt; matches render result list.

---

## Network Behaviour

- SEO-friendly URLs (when enabled) for post/page/category/archive/tag.
- Assets under `/assets/...` load with 200 (css/js/media).
- Failed asset requests are captured (no 404s in console/network).
- Document statuses: 200 on all valid routes; 404 template content on unknown paths.

---

## UI Components

- Header: skip-link, nav (#navbar-menu), brand (site name + tagline), language switcher
  (#languageMenu), toggler on mobile.
- Home: hero `<section class="hero">`, intro, `.featured-posts`, `.latest-posts`,
  `.gallery` grid.
- Sidebar: search form (#ajax-search-form), latest-posts, categories, archives, tags
  widgets.
- Single: `.post-single` content, `.post-tags`, `.posts-nav` (previous/next), comment form.
- Footer: footer-navigation, .social-menu, copyrights.

---

## Accessibility

- Skip link present and focused on tabbing.
- Semantic landmarks: `header`, `main`, `nav`, `footer`, `aside`.
- ARIA labels on interactive controls (menu toggle, language menu, search, social links).
- Focus-visible outline on all focusable elements.
- Alt text on all images.
- No keyboard traps; dropdown menu operable via keyboard.
- Color contrast >= 4.5:1 on text.

---

## Responsive

- Desktop (1440): multi-column layout (latest 3-col, footer columns).
- Tablet (768): content stacks; nav collapses to toggler.
- Mobile (320/360): no horizontal scroll; tap targets >= 44px; cards full-width.

---

## Browser Compatibility

Run the chromium, firefox, webkit projects.

---

## Security Expectations

- CSRF token present on search/comment forms.
- XSS payload in titles/content is inert (no script execution, no alert).
- Sensitive data (emails, passwords) not exposed in markup/console.
- Authorization: public view fine logged-out; protected content not leaked.

---

## Failure Scenarios

- Invalid post slug -> 404.
- Invalid download identifier -> 400 page (no header corruption).
- Empty search query -> prompt message, no crash.
- No posts exist -> "nothing found" message, no fatal.
- Slow network / timeout -> graceful, no partial script breakage.
- Double-submit of comment -> single submission.
- Expired session on protected unlock -> recoverable message.

---

## Recovery Behaviour

- 404/400 pages present a clear message and Back-to-Home link.
- Errors are not raw 500 stack traces; app returns a friendly page/status.
- Failed asset loads fall back without blocking page.

---

- Home (desktop, tablet, mobile)
- Single post (desktop + mobile)
- Sidebar widgets
- 404
- Comment form success/error states

---

## Console

- Report any JS errors, warnings, uncaught exceptions; assert none critical on load.

---

## Network

- Assert valid asset requests resolve (200); document any failed requests.

---

## Test Scenarios (prioritized)

Critical:
- Home loads with header+footer single instance, 200.
- Each valid route renders with its distinct template content.
- Unknown slug -> 404 template (Back-to-Home link), 200.
- Post/page/category/tag/archive permalinks resolve.
- Asset bundle (css/js) loads without 404.

High:
- Sidebar + footer nav links work.
- Search form submit (js-off => GET /search?q=) returns results.
- Responsive at 320/768/1440; toggler shake; no horizontal overflow.
- Keyboard reach every interactive control.
- Single post shows prev/next + tags + comment form.

Medium:
- Language switcher present and functional.
- Archive index lists months/years.
- No console errors on each surface.

Low / edge:
- Empty list states render "nothing found".
- 404 for unknown archive/category.
- Back/forward retain correct page.

Regression:
- Compare page count/region for header/footer presence across all the above.
- after remediation the same assertions stay green == no regression.

Performance:
- LCP element present per page; images lazy/embraced.

---

## Notes for the Generator Agent

Convert each scenario into `e2e/theme-baseline.spec.js` using stable selectors
(roles/labels) plus `data` present in the theme (ids: `navbar-menu`, `languageMenu`,
`main-content`, `ajax-search-form`, `.hero`, `.latest-posts`, `.gallery`, `.post-single`).
Assert HTTP via `page.response` / `page.waitForURL`, and use `webServer` to boot the app.
Mark project names chromium/firefox/webkit.
